title: Production Capacity Planning
thesis: Snowflake forecasts capacity and demand natively — no Spark jobs, no external forecasting tools, just SQL-based ML that updates every 5 minutes via Dynamic Tables

talking_points: 12 fabs producing 470,000 wafers per month across the Penang-Kulim corridor — 87% average utilization.
Three fabs approaching 95% capacity ceiling — FAB-003, FAB-007, and FAB-010.
RM 2.1 billion in quarterly revenue at risk from capacity constraints on committed customer orders.
show: Point at 470K wafers/month total capacity KPI
tabs.call_out: 3 fabs at 95% ceiling — RM 2.1B quarterly revenue at risk

transition.line: Let's drill into the demand-capacity gap to see where we're short.

talking_points: FAB-003 running 5nm node — demand exceeds capacity by 8,200 wafers next quarter.
ML.FORECAST projects FAB-007 will breach 95% utilization within 6 weeks at current booking rate.
Customer allocation conflict: 3 tier-1 customers competing for the same constrained capacity.
show: Show demand vs capacity gap chart by fab
Point at ML forecast confidence band
tabs.call_out: FAB-003: 8,200 wafer shortfall next quarter — ML.FORECAST confirms

transition.line: Where exactly is the bottleneck? Let's look at process step constraints.

talking_points: ML.TOP_INSIGHTS identifies lithography as the primary bottleneck driver in FAB-003 — 3 EUV tools at 98% loading.
Second constraint: wet etch capacity at FAB-007 limiting throughput for power semiconductor products.
Dynamic Tables update every 5 minutes — constraint severity recalculated as schedule changes flow in.
tabs.call_out: Lithography is the binding constraint — 3 EUV tools at 98%

transition.line: Let the VP ask the system directly about expansion options.

talking_points: Dr. Ooi asks: 'What's the revenue impact if FAB-003 stays at current capacity for 2 more quarters?'
Cortex Analyst calculates: RM 4.3 billion in deferred revenue from customer allocation cuts.
Switch to advisor: 'What CapEx options resolve the FAB-003 bottleneck?' — searches planning docs and recommends.
show: Type: 'Revenue impact if FAB-003 capacity unchanged for 2 quarters?'

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, 5-minute refresh, no Spark.

talking_points: Dynamic Tables refresh every 5 minutes — demand vs capacity always current, no batch jobs.
ML.FORECAST and ML.TOP_INSIGHTS replace Spark-based forecasting pipelines entirely.
12 fabs, 470K wafers/month, 1,500 customer orders, 200 constraints tracked — all in SQL.
tabs.call_out: 5-minute refresh, SQL-based ML, no external forecasting tools

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — capacity planning for semiconductor manufacturing.
